Map Bioregion Clusters and Spatially Interpolate Assignments

Source: R/map_bioreg.R
map_bioreg.Rd

Runs several unsupervised clustering algorithms on multivariate environmental data, aligns their cluster labels to a common k-means reference, visualises the resulting partitions (optionally), and produces gridded bioregion surfaces by nearest-neighbour (NN) and/or thin-plate-spline (TPS) interpolation.

Usage

map_bioreg(
  data,
  scale_cols,
  clus_method = "all",
  show_plot = TRUE,
  interp = "both",
  x_col = "x",
  y_col = "y",
  resolution = 0.5,
  bndy_fc = NULL
)

Arguments

data

Data frame containing longitude/latitude plus the variables in scale_cols.

scale_cols

Character vector of column names to z-scale before clustering.

clus_method

Which algorithm(s) to run: one or more of "kmeans", "pam", "hclust", "gmm", or "all".

show_plot

Logical; if TRUE (default), draw a 2×2 patchwork of the point-map partitions. Set FALSE to skip.

interp

Character; interpolation type: "NN", "Tps", or "both" (default).

x_col, y_col

Names of the longitude and latitude columns (defaults "x", "y").

resolution

Numeric; grid cell size for the interpolation raster.

bndy_fc

Optional sf or SpatVector polygon to overlay.

Value

A list with three elements:

data

Original data with factor cluster columns (kmeans_opt, pam_opt, pam_opt_aligned, hc_opt, hc_opt_aligned, gmm_opt, gmm_opt_aligned), all sharing levels 1…k.

interpolated

A SpatRaster of continuous NN or TPS predictions (one layer per algorithm).

clusters

A SpatRaster of re-classified discrete clusters (TPS only), with the same levels 1…k.
